title.tl: Birthday cash gift para sa senior citizen
title.en: Birthday cash gift for senior citizens

frequency.tl: Isang beses kada taon, sa buwan ng kaarawan
frequency.en: Once a year, in the birthday month

summary.tl: Cash gift ng Lungsod ng Calamba para sa mga senior citizen sa buwan ng kanilang kaarawan. Ayon sa ulat noong 2022, itinaas ito mula ₱500 tungong ₱1,000 at ipinamimigay sa mga barangay.
summary.en: A City of Calamba cash gift for senior citizens in their birthday month. A 2022 report says it was raised from ₱500 to ₱1,000 and is handed out at the barangays.

who.en: Senior citizens (60 and up) living in Calamba.

requirements.tl: Calamba Senior Citizen ID (OSCA)
requirements.en: Calamba Senior Citizen ID (OSCA)

note.tl: Kumpirmahin sa barangay o OSCA kung ano pa ang hinihingi.

steps.tl: Siguraduhing may Calamba Senior Citizen ID.
steps.en: Make sure you have a Calamba Senior Citizen ID.

steps.tl: Abangan ang anunsyo ng barangay para sa schedule ng inyong birth month.
steps.en: Watch for your barangay's announcement of the schedule for your birth month.

steps.tl: Pumunta sa barangay hall sa araw ng pamimigay dala ang ID.
steps.en: Go to the barangay hall on distribution day with your ID.

summary.tl: Ipinoproseso ng City Social Services ng Calamba. Makukuha sa loob ng hindi hihigit sa 20 araw dahil may pre-assessment, evaluation at home visit.
summary.en: Processed by Calamba's City Social Services. Released within 20 days at most because of pre-assessment, evaluation and a home visit.

requirements.tl: Solo Parent Application Form (makukuha sa City Social Services)
requirements.en: Solo Parent Application Form (from City Social Services)

requirements.en: Photocopy of minor children's birth certificates (PSA or City Civil Registry)

requirements.en: Photocopy of the child's PWD ID, if any

requirements.en: Original document proving your solo parent situation (e.g. a medical certificate if your spouse is a PWD who can no longer work)

title.tl: 20% discount at VAT exemption ng senior citizen
title.en: Senior citizen 20% discount and VAT exemption

frequency.tl: Tuwing bibili o gagamit ng serbisyo

summary.tl: Sa ilalim ng RA 9994, may 20% discount at VAT exemption ang senior citizen sa gamot, medical at dental services, pamasahe, hotel, restaurant, recreation at funeral services.
summary.en: Under RA 9994, senior citizens get a 20% discount and VAT exemption on medicines, medical and dental services, transport fares, hotels, restaurants, recreation and funeral services.

who.tl: Pilipinong senior citizen (60 pataas) na nakatira sa Pilipinas.
who.en: Filipino senior citizens (60 and up) living in the Philippines.

requirements.tl: Senior Citizen ID (ipakita bago magbayad)
requirements.en: Senior Citizen ID (show it before paying)

requirements.tl: Grocery/Medicine Booklet, para sa gamot at grocery
requirements.en: Grocery/Medicine Booklet, for medicines and groceries

steps.tl: Ipakita ang Senior Citizen ID bago magbayad.
steps.en: Show your Senior Citizen ID before paying.

steps.tl: Siguraduhing nakalagay ang discount sa resibo.
steps.en: Make sure the discount appears on the receipt.

sources.label: Republic Act No. 9994 – Expanded Senior Citizens Act of 2010

title.tl: Social pension para sa indigent senior citizen
title.en: Social pension for indigent senior citizens

summary.tl: Sa ilalim ng RA 11916, ang indigent senior citizen ay may buwanang social pension na hindi bababa sa ₱1,000.
summary.en: Under RA 11916, indigent senior citizens receive a monthly social pension of at least ₱1,000.

who.tl: Senior citizen na mahina o maysakit, walang pension (SSS/GSIS), walang regular na kita, at walang regular na suporta mula sa pamilya.
who.en: Senior citizens who are frail or sickly, have no pension (SSS/GSIS), no regular income, and no regular support from family.

requirements.tl: Valid ID na nagpapakita ng edad, hal. Senior Citizen ID
requirements.en: Valid ID showing age, e.g. Senior Citizen ID

requirements.tl: Social case study ng social worker (home visit)
requirements.en: Social case study by a social worker (home visit)

steps.tl: Magparehistro sa social welfare office ng lungsod (City Social Services).
steps.en: Register at the city's social welfare office (City Social Services).

steps.tl: Hintayin ang home visit at assessment ng social worker.
steps.en: Wait for the social worker's home visit and assessment.

steps.tl: Kapag naaprubahan, abangan ang schedule ng payout.
steps.en: Once approved, watch for the payout schedule.

sources.label: Republic Act No. 11916 – Increasing the Social Pension of Indigent Senior Citizens

amount_note.tl: ₱10,000 sa 80, 85, 90 at 95; ₱100,000 at sulat mula sa Pangulo sa 100
amount_note.en: ₱10,000 at 80, 85, 90 and 95; ₱100,000 plus a letter from the President at 100

frequency.tl: Isang beses sa bawat milestone; i-claim sa loob ng 1 taon
frequency.en: Once per milestone; claim within 1 year

summary.tl: Sa ilalim ng RA 11982 (Expanded Centenarians Act), may cash gift ang mga Pilipinong umabot sa 80, 85, 90, 95 at 100 taong gulang.
summary.en: Under RA 11982 (Expanded Centenarians Act), Filipinos who reach 80, 85, 90, 95 and 100 receive a cash gift.

who.tl: Pilipinong aabot o umabot sa 80, 85, 90, 95 o 100 sa loob ng nakaraang 1 taon.
who.en: Filipinos who reach or reached 80, 85, 90, 95 or 100 within the past year.

requirements.tl: Application form (mula sa ncsc.gov.ph o sa OSCA)
requirements.en: Application form (from ncsc.gov.ph or OSCA)

requirements.tl: Photocopy ng National ID, o PSA birth certificate (original o certified true copy)
requirements.en: Photocopy of National ID, or PSA birth certificate (original or certified true copy)

requirements.tl: Bagong 2x2 ID photo at full body picture na naka-print sa A4
requirements.en: Recent 2x2 ID photo and a full-body picture printed on A4

requirements.tl: Endorsement letter
requirements.en: Endorsement letter

steps.tl: Kumuha at sagutan ang form (ncsc.gov.ph o OSCA).
steps.en: Get and fill out the form (ncsc.gov.ph or OSCA).

steps.tl: Ipasa ang form at mga dokumento sa OSCA o social welfare office.
steps.en: Submit the form and documents to OSCA or the social welfare office.

steps.tl: Hintayin ang abiso ng NCSC sa schedule ng distribution.
steps.en: Wait for NCSC's notice of the distribution schedule.

steps.tl: Sa araw ng distribution, dalhin ang original at photocopy ng OSCA ID.
steps.en: On distribution day, bring the original and a photocopy of the OSCA ID.

free_note.tl: Ilegal ang anumang singil o kaltas sa cash gift.
free_note.en: Any fee or deduction from the cash gift is illegal.

summary.en: Under RA 11861, solo parents earning minimum wage or less get a ₱1,000 monthly subsidy funded by their city or municipality.

who.tl: Solo parent na minimum wage pababa ang kita at hindi tumatanggap ng ibang cash assistance mula sa gobyerno. Puwedeng ituloy ang senior o PWD benefits.
who.en: Solo parents earning minimum wage or less who receive no other government cash assistance. Senior or PWD benefits may continue.

summary.en: Under RA 11861, solo parents get a 10% discount and VAT exemption on milk, food, diapers, medicines and supplements for a child up to 6 years old.

summary.en: Solo parent employees with at least 6 months of service get up to 7 days of parental leave a year.
